segments.name: USA Operations
segments.description: Explores for and produces oil and gas in the United States.
segments.evidence: Ovintiv's operating and reportable segments are: • USA Operations includes the exploration for, development of, and production and marketing of oil, NGLs, natural gas and other related activities within the United States, which includes Permian in west Texas and Anadarko in west-central Oklahoma.

segments.name: Corporate and Other
segments.description: Holds corporate costs and sublease rentals.
segments.evidence: Corporate and Other also includes amounts related to sublease rentals and administrative costs not allocated to the operating segments.
